description: Use when inspecting scheduled publications, delivery failures or messages previously published by Postlyra. Returns publicationId for rescheduling, cancellation, targeted edits or deletion.

channelId.description: Owner-bound channel id from list_channels; never invent a recipient.

from.description: Inclusive lower scheduledAt bound as ISO 8601 with UTC offset, e.g. 2026-10-28T09:00:00+07:00.

limit.description: Maximum items to return in this page; observe the schema bounds.

offset.description: Zero-based number of matching items to skip; use nextOffset from the preceding page.

sort.description: Default newest first by scheduledAt; use oldest for chronological planning.

status.description: Delivery status filter: queued, sending, sent, retrying, uncertain, failed, blocked_by_limit, canceled or deleted.

to.description: Inclusive upper scheduledAt bound as ISO 8601 with UTC offset, e.g. 2026-10-28T18:00:00+07:00.

name: list_publications
title: Read publication calendar
